Name: Nightmare Before Christmas Farm
Author: ForteChiller
Description:
This save file contains a farm map with a farm set up to mimick Halloween Town from The Nightmare Before Christmas. There's a ton of references and easter eggs, as well as fully functioning farm equipment and machines. There's also a space for farming crops and raising animals to keep the farm able to continue to produce goods. All major and minor denizens of Halloween Town have a home, with the farmer serving as Jack Skellington the Pumpkin King himself! The player's horse is a reference to Death's horse, and the dog is named Zero. It was made using a few mods, but the[b] only required mod is Tractor Mod![/b]

Installation
[list=1]
[*]Download savegame file;
[*]Extract it from the .zip file;
[*]Copy save files to possible savegames location;
[*]Make a backup of your save before adding!
[/list]
Example of the savegame folder location
[list]
[*] C:\Users\%UserName%\AppData\Roaming\StardewValley\Saves
[/list]
